definitions.gloss: the degree of saltiness; the amount of salt used
definitions.explanation: refers to how salty something is or the appropriate amount of salt to use in cooking

examples.japanese: {塩加減|しおかげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
{塩加減|しおかげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
お⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩加減|しおかげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Adjust the saltiness of the miso soup.

notes:
COOKING TERM:
{塩加減|しおかげん} is an essential concept in Japanese cooking. The word combines ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) + ⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ (degree/adjustment).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {塩加減|しおかげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ - to taste for saltiness
- {塩加減|しおかげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ - saltiness is hard to get right
- {塩加減|しおかげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧ - to adjust the salt level

RELATED ～{加減|かげん} WORDS:
- {味加減|あじかげん} - seasoning (general)
- {甘|あま}さ⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ - sweetness level
- ⟦{火加減|ひかげん}→火加減：06656_hikagen⟧ - heat level
- ⟦{湯加減|ゆかげん}→湯加減：28875_yukagen⟧ - water/bath temperature

TIPS:
{塩加減|しおかげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{足|た}せる→足す：01168_tasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戻|もど}せない→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ - "You can always add more salt, but you can't remove it if you add too much."
